message: exceedsApprovalThreshold compares a raw float sum to a cents threshold, so a request exactly at the threshold can be flagged as over it.
The comment for hiding the note on submitted requests says the request already counts toward the cap, which no longer explains the API threshold that leaves this ASR out.
The new guard that returns null unless both approvalThreshold and approvalThresholdReason are present has no test for the null path in useFormUserInfo.test.ts.
